rationale: The workflow is a single-job, single-step issue labeler triggered on issues.opened. It already uses a pinned third-party action and performs a minimal, fast operation. None of the evidence-supported patterns fit: there is no matrix to apply fail-fast to, no dependency installation to cache, no Bazel build to tune, no scheduled runs to suppress, no tests to select or prioritize, and no change-path filtering relevant to an issue trigger. The custom-timeout pattern requires representative successful-duration history, which is not available (CI history shows only failures), and the stale-run cancellation pattern requires runs on the same branch/PR where a newer revision supersedes older checks, which does not apply to per-issue runs. Adding any of these would either be unsupported by the evidence or risk altering required-check behavior without measurable benefit.
